## Changes

- Download chapters to read offline. Long-press chapters on a series page to select them, then tap the download icon. Downloads keep going in the background and while the phone is locked, with a progress notification (the app asks for notification permission the first time).
- Downloaded chapters open from the phone, with or without a connection. Chapter rows show whether a chapter is queued, downloading (3/10) or saved.
- New **Lainnya → Unduhan** screen: storage used, the download queue with retry and cancel, and downloads grouped per series (tap a series to show its chapters, swipe a chapter to delete it).
- Without a connection, series you have downloaded, bookmarked or read still open from the details saved on the phone.
- Tap a genre on a series page to browse that genre in Jelajah.
- Clearing the image cache no longer touches downloads.
